City Council Approves New Transit Budget

May 14, 2026

The city council voted seven to two on Tuesday to approve a transit budget of 48 million dollars for the coming fiscal year, an increase of twelve percent over the previous plan.

The measure funds forty new electric buses and extends the northern light-rail line by three stops, reaching the university district by 2028. Officials said construction bids will open in September.

Opponents argued the plan relies on optimistic ridership projections. An independent audit is scheduled for early next year to review the assumptions behind the forecast.
